title: MavLinOS design-system common vocabulary
description: Shared definitions used by every mavlinos.* schema. Nothing here is optional in the sense of 'we will add it later': provenance and evidence are what make an extracted fact usable by someone who never met the extraction agent.

kind.description: How the value came into existence. Legacy 'kind' from docs/UI_REFERENCE/data/*.json is the same vocabulary, extended by two honest additions (inferred, proposed) so we never have to dress a guess up as a measurement.

confidence.description: high = exact and reproducible; medium = bounded by an explicit tolerance; low = order-of-magnitude; unverified = asserted, no evidence attached.

evidence_ref.description: src:<source key> = a checked-in artifact (see provenance.artifact / sources registry); capture:<id> = a capture in captures/index.json (md5-pinned); lit:<id> = external literature entry. Raw file names are NOT accepted as evidence.

status.description: draft = not usable yet; proposed = contract-complete, not validated; verified = validated against the original by the reference renderer; deprecated = do not use.

provenance.description: Where this record's values came from and how to re-derive them. 'artifact' must be a path or URL that still resolves, or an explicit statement that the artifact is outside git.

artifact.description: Path/URL of the artifact the values were read from (e.g. System/Library/Frameworks/AppKit.framework/Versions/C/AppKit).

artifact_sha256.description: Hash of that artifact. Required whenever the artifact is inside git; otherwise state 'external-guest' in notes.

guest.description: Identifier of the reference guest the artifact belongs to (see docs/UI_REFERENCE/PROVENANCE.md).

extractor.description: Script that produced the value, so it can be re-run.

gap.description: An honest hole. A record with gaps is allowed to live; a record that hides a gap by guessing is not.

resolution.description: What must happen to close it. 'hardware' is never an acceptable resolution for a software gap.

blocks.description: Ids of components/behaviours that cannot be finished until this gap closes.

token_ref.description: Reference to a design token id (design/tokens/design-tokens.json). Components must never hardcode a colour or a size: the token is the single definition.

rect.description: Axis-aligned rectangle. 'origin' is declared per record, never assumed.

rgb.description: #rrggbb only. Alpha lives in its own field so colour maths stays in one place.
